hypotheses.title: GARP Inflection & Analyst Revision Acceleration Synergy (Batch 143 C3 Refinement)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Direct revision of Batch 143 Candidate 3. Batch 143 C3 achieved Sharpe 0.82 with ultralow 4.86% turnover and well-distributed weights. Adding analyst revision momentum (analyst_revision_rank_derivative) injects short-term institutional consensus drift into slow valuation-growth compounding, elevating turnover from 4.8% to the optimal 11% fitness sweet-spot and pushing Sharpe >= 1.50.
confounders: Analyst herding bias at macroeconomic inflection points
Multiple compression in broad growth equity corrections
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha returns fail during hyper-speculative junk rallies where zero-growth, highly indebted stocks drastically outperform.

candidates.rationale: Combines 100% coverage GARP inflection with analyst revision momentum within subindustry

hypotheses.title: Regime-Conditioned Volume Elasticity & Native Channel Scaling (Batch 143 C2 Refinement)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Corrects platform operator syntax by replacing non-existent ts_min/ts_max with native WorldQuant ts_scale(close, 20). Uses trade_when to dynamically switch between rolling return-volume correlation (ts_corr) during institutional volume accumulation and 20-day channel oscillator positioning (ts_scale) during normal regimes.
confounders: Index rebalancing days causing non-informative volume spikes
hypotheses.falsification_test: Performance degrades significantly when conditioning is removed or when tested with unneutralized market beta exposure.

candidates.expression: trade_when(volume > ts_mean(volume, 60), group_rank(ts_corr(returns, volume, 20), subindustry), group_rank(ts_scale(close, 20), subindustry))
candidates.rationale: trade_when switching between ts_corr price-volume decoupling and native ts_scale channel breakout

hypotheses.title: Multiplicative Style Decile Inflection with Low-Decay Calibration
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Direct rank-normalized variant of Batch 143 C3. Ranks each factor prior to multiplicative interaction, eliminating right-tail weight concentration. Because base turnover is only 4.86%, running with decay=3 (or decay=2) significantly enhances signal responsiveness and sub-universe Sharpe without exceeding turnover friction limits.
confounders: High intra-industry dispersion driven by micro-cap illiquidity
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha inverts during broad junk rallies characterized by extreme distress outperformance.

candidates.rationale: Rank-normalized multiplicative GARP interaction tested at decay=3 to boost sub-universe Sharpe
